newsitem.title: USA: Mazda sets recall of 1993-95 RX-7 cars.
newsitem.headline: Mazda sets recall of 1993-95 RX-7 cars.

text.p: Mazda Motor Co said Tuesday it is recalling 13,900 1993 to 1995 model year RX-7 sports cars to replace brake vacuum hoses.
On certain cars, engine oil mist may accumulate on the brake vacuum check valve, preventing the valve from opening at the correct pressure and causing diminished braking performance.
Onwers are being asked to bring their cars to Mazda dealers for the repair, which takes about 30 minutes.

A Mazda spokesman Fred Aikins said the company is not aware of any injuries or accidents as a result of the condition. He would not disclose how much the recall will cost, but noted the new vacuum hose is a relatively inexpensive part.
